summary: Iteration 8: Tested biller_code and reference_number extraction, admin payment processing features. Fixed critical bug in AdminPayments.jsx where API URL was missing /api prefix. All core features working correctly.

minor.issue: Test design issue - test_admin_pay_already_paid_bill_returns_404 fails because fixture creates new bill for each test method. Not a backend bug.

critical_code_review_comments: Fixed bug: AdminPayments.jsx was using process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL without /api prefix, causing 404 errors on admin payment queue endpoint
Added biller_code and reference_number fields to BillUploadDialog.jsx for consistency with AccurassiBillExtractor
Bill extraction correctly extracts Biller Code and Reference Number from PDFs using regex patterns
Admin Payment Processing page correctly displays pending bills grouped by provider with biller codes and reference numbers
seed_data_creation: Created test bills with biller_code and reference_number for testing, cleaned up after tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 8 complete. All biller_code and reference_number features working. Admin Payment Processing page at /admin/payments is fully functional - shows pending bills grouped by provider with biller codes, reference numbers, customer details, and pay buttons. Bill extraction from PDFs correctly extracts Biller Code (regex: biller\s*code|bpay\s*biller\s*code) and Reference Number (regex: ref[:\s]+\d{6,20}). BillUploadDialog and AccurassiBillExtractor both have biller_code and reference_number input fields. Customer bills table shows Biller Code and Reference columns.

features_verified.bill_extraction_reference_number: PASS - POST /api/bills/extract correctly extracts reference_number from PDF (tested with Ref: 901234567812)
features_verified.create_bill_with_biller_code: PASS - POST /api/bills accepts and saves biller_code and reference_number fields
features_verified.get_bills_with_biller_code: PASS - GET /api/bills returns bills with biller_code and reference_number fields
features_verified.admin_payment_queue: PASS - GET /api/admin/payment-queue returns pending bills with biller_code, reference_number, user_name, user_email grouped by provider
features_verified.admin_pay_single_bill: PASS - POST /api/admin/pay-bill marks bill as paid with payment_reference
features_verified.admin_pay_bills_bulk: PASS - POST /api/admin/pay-bills-bulk marks multiple bills as paid
features_verified.admin_access_control: PASS - Admin endpoints return 403 for non-admin users
features_verified.frontend_bills_table_columns: PASS - Customer bills table shows Biller Code and Reference columns
features_verified.frontend_bill_extractor_form: PASS - AccurassiBillExtractor has biller_code and reference_number input fields
features_verified.frontend_bill_upload_dialog: PASS - BillUploadDialog has biller_code and reference_number input fields (added in this iteration)
features_verified.frontend_admin_sidebar: PASS - Admin sidebar has 'Payment Processing' nav item
features_verified.frontend_admin_payments_page: PASS - Admin Payment Processing page shows pending bills grouped by provider with biller codes, reference numbers, pay buttons
features_verified.frontend_admin_single_pay: PASS - Admin can enter payment reference and click Pay on single bill
features_verified.frontend_admin_bulk_pay: PASS - Admin can select multiple bills and bulk pay with payment reference

bug_fixed.issue: Admin Payment Processing page showed 'Failed to load payment queue' error and displayed 0 pending bills
bug_fixed.root_cause: AdminPayments.jsx was using 'const API = process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL' which results in URL without /api prefix. The correct pattern used in other components is 'const API = process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL + '/api''
bug_fixed.fix: Changed line 12 in AdminPayments.jsx from 'const API = process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL;' to 'const API = process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL + '/api';'
